sourceState: Recorded commit plus preserved dirty integration work. Exact runtime/config/test inputs are listed per run; this is not clean-commit evidence.

environment.device: No physical Apple device. 390x844 and 844x390 viewport checks are browser layout evidence.
environment.server: Same-process Vite development server; no claim that localhost is a live URL

changedInputsDuringRun.exactChange: One trailing LF removed. SHA256(final bytes plus LF) matches the pre-run hash. No executable import behavior changed.
changedInputsDuringRun.HMR: Vite reported an update to SpatialWorkspace.tsx while the stress case was running. All 19 cases passed, but this run is not represented as every input unchanged.

runs.command: SPATIAL_BROWSER_EXECUTABLE="$PWD/tests/ui/.browser-runtime/chromium" npx playwright test --config tests/ui/playwright.config.ts --grep "real authoring|colliding source|complete local backup"

SPATIAL_BROWSER_EXECUTABLE="$PWD/tests/ui/.browser-runtime/chromium" npx playwright test --config tests/ui/playwright.config.ts --grep "narrow viewport|mobile model controls|200 percent text|synthetic safe-area"
runs.reason: Verified Capacitor WKWebView fills display with automatic content insets disabled and viewport-fit=cover. Added scoped env(safe-area-inset-top/left/right) padding; existing bottom handling retained. Only impacted mobile checks repeated.
runs.syntheticInsetCaveat: CSS properties simulate portrait top59px and landscape left/right59px insets. This verifies responsive layout and working controls, not device notch or native WKWebView behavior.

colliding source imports offer explicit separate retention and reopen exact copies without replacing corrections
drawn semantic areas, floors and room merge operate on saved geometry with undo

complete local backup reimports the separately retained source identity through the actual workspace
visible floor taps move through a permitted door and stop at a window between the same rooms
plan framing and orbit framing survive view switches and display ceilings do not alter geometry
mobile model controls stay reachable and held walking stops after release
200 percent text stays operable on a narrow screen and persists as a display preference
Synthetic safe-area insets preserve portrait correction, landscape content bounds and actual walking controls
